description.value: Eddie Mountain Memorial Arena (EMMA) is a community sports facility operated by the Regional District of East Kootenay (RDEK), located in the Columbia Valley area of the East Kootenays. As a municipal arena, it serves the surrounding communities with ice and recreational programming. Touring cyclists passing through the Kootenays may find it a potential rest stop, though specific cyclist-oriented services are unconfirmed.
